name: iCloud Mail
username: IMAP: usually the part of your address before the @ (try the full address if that fails). SMTP: your full iCloud address.
authentication: An app-specific password, generated from your Apple Account — not your normal Apple password.
notes: On Apple devices that meet iCloud’s requirements, use the built-in iCloud settings instead.
Thunderbird uses the documented usual IMAP local part and full SMTP address; if IMAP fails, Apple recommends trying the full address.
